arStrings.szText: Legacy of the Sightless
To bring clarity to her strange visions, a bold Seer aims to restore the Sightless Eye.
Athrpa seeks entrance to an ancient chamber within the temple, one which few have entered in recent times. Knowledge about the Eye, and how to restore it, might lie within.
Slay the hostile spirits
Athrpa seeks entrance to an ancient chamber within the temple, one which few have entered in recent times. Knowledge about the Eye, and how to restore it, might lie within.
Unlock the Sealed Door

Ghosts of the past stir at the Sepulture of Scales. Do they fear us? Do they hate us? Or are they merely stirred into a frenzy by the lingering power of the Sightless Eye? Despite the dangers, Athrpa is undeterred. I must help her find the answers she seeks.
Enter the Sepulture of Scales
Athrpa has seen troubling visions, and she believes that by restoring the Eye, she can unlock the meaning of her premonitions. If I help her, I might learn something important as well.
Inspect the Archival Transcript

Ancient texts speak of the Eye first being awakened in the Temple of Life. If there is a way to restore the artifact, the answer might lie there. I should meet Athrpa at the temple and see how I can help her.
Find Seer Athrpa in the Temple of Life
Athrpa seeks entrance to an ancient chamber within the temple, one which few have entered in recent times. Knowledge about the Eye, and how to restore it, might lie within.
Speak with Seer Athrpa

A voice spoke to us: Lycander. The angel who once dwelled on Skovos alongside Lilith and Inarius. She warned us to abandon our quest to restore the Eye. Perhaps we should heed her advice, but Athrpa is not ready to give up. I should meet her back at the Temple of Life.
Speak with Seer Athrpa in the Temple of Life
The Sightless Eye was once the fulcrum of the Oracle order. Now it is broken and devoid of its power. Yet there is one Seer named Athrpa who seems intent on restoring the Eye. I should learn why.
